verdict.rationale: Figma's own docs show native variables used as tokens for spacing, color, radius and typography. A Variables REST API supports querying, creating, updating and deleting them and syncing a design system source of truth. Nothing in the pack documents modes or themes, or switching variable values across designs. Missing for 10: documented support for variable modes/themes, evidence of applying a mode or theme across designs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the designer-facing token workflow.

support.subject: As a designer, I can manage design tokens or variables — colors, spacing, typography — with modes or themes applied across designs

citations.quote: Use Figma variables for tokens. Apply variables for spacing, color, radius, and typography.
`get_variable_defs` extracts the **variables and styles** used in your selection (color, spacing, typography, etc).
The Variables REST API includes endpoints for querying, creating, updating, and deleting variables.
Sync design system source of truth to and from Figma
